newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S MANUEL, STALS TO ADDRESS CONFERENCE FRI.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S MANUEL, STALS TO ADDRESS CONFERENCE FRI.

text.p: South African Finance Minister Trevor Manuel, Reserve Bank Governor Chris Stals and Finance Director General Maria Ramos are due to address the annual Bureau for Economic Research (BER) conference on Friday.
The BER said other speakers included Mark Orkin, head of the Central Statistical Services, and Conrad Strauss, chairman of Standard Bank group .
